primary.missingReason: Three E2 outputs were terminal schema-invalid responses caused by Markdown code fences around otherwise JSON-looking payloads.

postHocFenceStripSensitivity.classification: post-hoc sensitivity only; not part of registered primary result
postHocFenceStripSensitivity.method: Mechanically removed outer Markdown code fences from the three invalid E2 payloads without changing embedded JSON content.

evaluatorCeiling.interpretation: The case/rubric combination has a severe ceiling effect and weak discriminative power.

repeatability.limitation: No blinded semantic scoring was performed on repeatability runs, so exact byte mismatch should not be treated as semantic instability.

supportCriteria.marginAtLeastFive: not-met on complete cases; full registered statistic unavailable because 3 pairs lack two valid evaluator scores
supportCriteria.bothAnalyzerFamiliesPositive: not-met on complete cases because A1 mean difference is 0.0

conclusion.boundedInterpretation: The available two-family evidence does not show material incremental semantic value for EDF over a strong matched-neutral structured prompt under these six synthetic cases. This does not establish that EDF has no value in other tasks or that individual EDF constructs lack value.
conclusion.nextDesignImplication: Use harder, less ceiling-prone cases and a more discriminating scoring design, then test EDF-specific constructs through targeted ablations rather than another whole-framework prompt comparison.
